name: TRELLIS.2
what: Microsoft's open 4B-parameter image-to-3D model. It turns an image into a fully textured 3D asset, including PBR attributes (base color, roughness, metallic, opacity), and handles open surfaces and non-manifold geometry. It ships with inference code, training code, pretrained weights and a Gradio web demo. MIT licensed; some dependencies have their own licenses.
who: Technical artists and indie devs with a strong NVIDIA GPU who want to generate 3D assets from concept art. It needs Linux and an NVIDIA GPU with at least 24 GB of memory.
